entries.zh: 三；数词“三”（文白两读）
entries.en: three

entries.zh: 三个；“三”带量词“个”
entries.en: three (with the generic classifier 个)
entries.notes: 音写栏声调标记污损难辨（T99）；字义据西语 Tres、汉字“三个”、音写 sã çe 三栏互证。

entries.zh: 申时；午后三至五时（西语“午后三点过一刻”即申时）
entries.en: the shen double-hour (3–5 p.m.); a quarter past three in the afternoon
entries.notes: 汉字栏残损仅存“申”；据音写 sin-sī 与西语 tres y quarto de la tarde 互证为申时，释义本身较明确。

entries.zh: 及第；科举应试中选、取得功名
entries.en: to pass the imperial examination; to attain a (academic) degree or rank

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 卅；三十
entries.en: thirty

entries.zh: 三十
entries.en: thirty

entries.zh: 三旬；三十日（一月三旬），亦以三十计月、日、年（字形句/旬存疑）
entries.en: three ten-day periods (= thirty days, one month); thirty as counted of months, days, years (character uncertain: 句/旬)
entries.notes: 汉字句/旬两可且声调标记污损（T99）；据音写 çun(un) 与西语 meses、dias、anos 计数语境暂拟为“旬”。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 吏部；六部之一（居首），掌官员铨选、任免，即“安置官吏之衙门”
entries.en: Ministry of Personnel; the tribunal (Board) where mandarins are appointed

entries.zh: 兵部；六部之一，掌军政兵事
entries.en: Ministry of War (Board of War)

entries.zh: 户部；六部之一，掌户口、田赋、财计
entries.en: Ministry of Revenue (Board of Finance; Sp. hacienda)
entries.notes: 音写栏声调标记污损（T99）；字义据汉字“户部”与西语 tribunal de hacienda 互证。

entries.zh: 刑部；六部之一，掌刑狱司法
entries.en: Ministry of Justice (Board of Punishments)

entries.zh: 工部；六部之一，掌工程营造修缮
entries.en: Ministry of Works (Board of Public Works; Sp. reparos)

entries.zh: 礼部；六部之一，掌礼仪、文教、宾礼（西语以 criança 养成教化当之）
entries.en: Ministry of Rites (Board of Rites and Ceremonies)

entries.zh: 亭；本义亭榭，此处指公堂、判事之厅（参下判亭、判事亭、官亭诸条）
entries.en: pavilion; hall — here a court-hall, place of judgment (tribunal)

entries.zh: 判亭；判案之公堂，官长（alcalde）听讼断案之所
entries.en: judgment hall; the court where the alcalde sits in judgment
entries.notes: 音写栏声调标记污损（T99），西语 q̃ 展开依赖推断；判亭=判事公堂据汉字与西语互证。

entries.zh: 判事亭；公堂、法庭，审理案件之所
entries.en: court-house; tribunal where lawsuits are judged
entries.notes: 音写栏声调标记污损（T99）；字义据汉字与西语 tribunal 互证。

entries.zh: 官亭；官府厅堂，官设衙署
entries.en: official hall; government office (tribunal)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕

entries.zh: 彙（字形彙/隸存疑）；汇集、总聚〔原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to collect, to assemble (character uncertain: 彙/隸; doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字彙/隸两可、声调标记污损（T99）、西语词头截断为 Tribun-，仅按彙=汇集暂拟。

entries.zh: 税；赋税、贡税，亦指租金（租借之费，西语 alquiler）
entries.en: tax, tribute; rent, hire fee
